theorems.name: Submission.rsod_tendsto_scaled_mult_integral
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen U → ∀ (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (x : Amb n ℓ) (P : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ)), x ∈ U → Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n V.carrier V.mult x P → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => (r ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ z in V.carrier ∩ closedBall x r, V.mult z ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (unitBallVolume n * V.mult x))
